video.transcript:
Photosynthesis: Inputs, Energy, and Outputs

Photosynthesis uses sunlight to combine carbon dioxide and water, producing carbohydrates such as sugars and oxygen. Sunlight supplies energy; it is not material converted into plant mass. [s1]

Start with the basic idea

Plants use energy from sunlight to combine carbon dioxide and water. This process produces carbohydrates—including sugars—and oxygen. [s1]

Inputs and outputs

The inputs are carbon dioxide, water, and sunlight. The outputs are carbohydrates (including sugars) and oxygen. Sunlight provides energy for the process; it is not an input that becomes plant mass. [s1]

A carbon-cycle link

Photosynthesis moves carbon from the atmosphere into living organisms. [s1]

Track the process

As a simple way to remember the inputs and outputs, imagine a plant using carbon dioxide and water with energy from sunlight; the process produces sugars and oxygen. This is a hypothetical illustration of the process described in [s1].

Follow the inputs to the outputs

Inputs

Carbon dioxide + water

Energy

Sunlight supplies the energy; it is not converted into plant mass.

Outputs

Carbohydrates, including sugars + oxygen

Photosynthesis. The process in which plants use energy from sunlight to combine carbon dioxide and water into carbohydrates and oxygen. [s1]

Carbohydrates. Products of photosynthesis that include sugars. [s1]

video.transcript:
Haɗa abinci ta amfani da hasken rana (photosynthesis)

Za mu fara da abubuwan da tsarin ke amfani da su da waɗanda yake samarwa.

Menene photosynthesis?

Photosynthesis tsari ne da tsirrai ke amfani da makamashin hasken rana don haɗa carbon dioxide da ruwa, su samar da carbohydrates (ciki har da sukari) da oxygen.

Matsayin haske

Hasken rana yana ba da makamashin da tsarin ke buƙata. Ba ya rikidewa ya zama kayan jikin shuka (plant mass).

Misali na tunani

A ɗauka cewa shuka tana amfani da carbon dioxide da ruwa tare da makamashin hasken rana. Abubuwan da za a sa ran samarwa su ne carbohydrates, ciki har da sukari, da oxygen.

Abubuwan shiga da fita a photosynthesis

Abubuwan shiga

Carbon dioxide + ruwa

Makamashi

Hasken rana yana samar da makamashin tsarin.

Abubuwan fita

Carbohydrates (ciki har da sukari) + oxygen

Photosynthesis. Tsarin amfani da makamashin hasken rana don haɗa carbon dioxide da ruwa, a samar da carbohydrates da oxygen. (s1)

Carbon dioxide. Iskar da tsirrai ke amfani da ita tare da ruwa wajen photosynthesis. (s1)

Carbohydrates. Abubuwan da photosynthesis ke samarwa; sun haɗa da sukari. (s1)
